**Row added** 2026-11-25T07:07Z, at seat 3's request (mailbox #36743, 7155462225). Source: the three accepted prose nits in PR #37240's contract review (L2 7155394437), for ADR-0160's second amendment (#37202).

- [ ] **ADR-0160, the second amendment's three prose nits.** (1) "a door whose own page cap is lower … cuts the list at that cap" declares a door member that `main` does not have. `door.ts` has no page cap; the cap lives in the tool handlers. Say "row 11" there, as the record does for the cap's number. (2) "a string that only contains braces is a literal" should read "a value that merely contains braces". (3) The link-field sentence beside the new rule still says "that caller's schema hides". It should match the rule next to it: "cannot query on" (outside `getQueryableFields`). Prerequisite: PR #37240 merged (not yet).

repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As92T28dA9wc7wtu3iE

**Row added** 2026-11-25T11:59Z by the landing seat of #35885 (PR #37268, merged; `Part of #35885`). Source: PR #37268's `## Acceptance notes`, first bullet (the dev's proposed text, accepted at the seat's L1).

- [ ] **ADR-0158, Open item 9 (trailing note) and Open item 12 (Dry-run-and-apply point)** — `docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md`. Prerequisite: PR #37268 merged (met).
  - Open item 9 — what is true now: a `unitField` re-pointed onto a field new in the same save, or unstored before it, raises `unit_mode_to_record` on the quantity, for the blanks beside it; one re-pointed onto a field that already was a unit code field raises nothing in R1 (the sibling of `currency_field_repointed`). The dated note says that, in place of the sentence #35885 carried.
  - Open item 12 — the ADR says "A preview cut short at its row limit is reported as truncated". What is true now: a walk cut short at its row limit judges only the rows it examined: an apply run writes those, and the report says that the rows past the limit were not judged, as the currency backfill's does; a mapping entry whose key is stored as a unit code and that no row used is named in the report.
  - Unchanged and not to be touched: the `unit_mode_to_record` describe in the spec and the generated protocol reference (the code list did not move).

The dev's proposed note text is in PR #37371's body.

**Row added** 2026-11-26T01:10Z (area o5-D), an open item a landing PR answers.

- [ ] **ADR-0158, L4's last sentence and Open item 10** (from #35498, PR #37389). The ADR says: "For a standard code, a unit's org-editable decimal places have no home: Open item 10." What is true after PR #37389: the home is `sys_standard_unit_setting` (`packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-standard-unit-setting.object.ts`), answering Open item 10 option A (the maintainer's ruling record on #35339, comment 7008551416, verbatim 「组织可改,新开一处设置」). Settled on #35498 (claim amendments 7178077326, 7178144166).
  - **Notes to append (add-only, dated):** under U3 (standard codes never become `sys_unit` rows; their setting is the separate object), U6 (one home per kind of code: org unit → `sys_unit.decimal_places`; standard code → the org's `sys_standard_unit_setting` row; U1 carries no default), L4 (the pointer is superseded; L4 binds the value unchanged: display default only, never above the field's `scale`, nothing rounds at write), Open item 10 (answered: a `sys_*` object following `sys_unit.decimal_places`, not a settings key like ADR-0144 D4's `localization.currency`; `code` text with an exact-uppercase format rule over U1's codes, unique per organization, immutable; `decimal_places` 0–12 required; clearing = deleting the row, and a remaining row makes organization delete refuse `DELETE_RESTRICTED`; `member_default` read, `organization_admin` create/edit/delete, external members no read; `sys_audit_log` records old/new values; the reader ships with #35490).
  - **Full draft:** the card thread's text in the report on #35498.
  - **Order:** after PR #37389 merges.

**Row added** 2026-11-26T14:51Z by seat repo:objectstack#6, carrying item 2 of os-warren's handoff on #37130 (7183559260). Source: PR #37423's body, section "ADR-0010 note" (PR merged 2026-11-26, `Fixes #37130`).

- [ ] **ADR-0010, the amendment note of 2026-11-24 (#37013, PR #37021), line 247.** The ADR says "a rollback whose row is the platform's own record is refused (`409`)". What is true now: the refusal covers every restore door, not only the service's `rollback`. The dated note should say "a restore whose row is the platform's own record is refused (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`) at the metadata service's `rollback` and at the metadata protocol's `rollbackMetaItem` and the restore limb of `revertCommit`". Prerequisite: PR #37423 merged (met).

> **Note (2026-11-24, #36166, following #35823 / PR #36138)** — on §3.5's rename sentence "a name that lacks the package's prefix takes it in front". On the unmanaged rename path that sentence now has three bounds. (1) A package that declares no `namespace` is refused, not renamed, when no object name carries the namespace derived from its id and two or more object names share a first segment: each object of each such group is refused (`400 INVALID_REQUEST`), whether every object shares the segment (#36138) or a stray object stands beside the group (#36166). So two-word short names the package repeats (`purchase_order` beside `purchase_item`) are refused too, and declaring `namespace` lifts the refusal. (2) A package that declares a `namespace` is refused for each object name the namespace-prefix judge (`validateObjectNamespacePrefix`) refuses under it. The rename has no declared prefix in such a name to replace, and every authoring door already refuses that name. (3) Decided to stay as written: a namespace-less package's single object, foreign prefix or not (`demoasset_asset` alone copies as `TARGET_demoasset_asset`), because one name cannot tell a two-word short name from a foreign prefix. Namespace-less object names that share no first segment (`purchase_order` beside `asset_owner`, bare `asset` beside `site`) also stay as written. A body that writes the id-derived namespace out as `namespace` is judged as declared, so bound (2) applies to it and the shapes in (3) are refused for it. Pinned in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-unmanaged-install.test.ts`.
